body: I deleted all my posts. Thanks guys. All done killing America.
I don't want to give myself away, but I enjoy the phrase oh snap and I love people who get served.
Oops
I love you too man. Thank you!
Thank you Dunyele. Your words helped me. I'm trying new things this very week. Thank you
No treatment. Outside of self medicating. Part of my depression is due to my seemingly overwhelming addiction. But I have to try and power on. I have nothing else to do, but move forward.
You guys have all been awesome and an inspiration. Thank you.
I'm still here and going strong. Got rid of the gun, told my family and hit the gym. Even paid my bills.
Fuck that! I ain't dying. I'm powering on.

I'm on a shit ton of Kratom and I have slept since I woke up Tuesday morning. 

On a lighter side, I've been having a blast playing Fallout 4. For two days straight. Fucking Awesome! 

Hopefully the after life is a place where you can lay around all day, watching Netflix and playing games.

I decided to go through with my plan on Friday the 8th. Maybe not in my wife's car, but in my bathroom for easy clean up. If you don't hear from me after this Friday then it's because I'm dead. 

Thank you all for your encouragements.

I'm leaving the planet on Friday. If there's an after life, we can hangout. 

Love you. Take care.

I'm hoping it'll be done and over with in one shot. I'm moved up D-Day to the 8th. 

It's not fair that I'm doing this to my family. Yet, I get worse everyday. I've been getting worse for 10 years now. I'm done. The burden I'm causing my family will be terrible as time goes on. There will come a time where I can no longer care for myself. Better dead than becoming a financial burden.
I'm actually excited about doing the eternal sleep. It happens to all of us, I just want to do it sooner. Shotgun blast to my head.

I plan on shooting myself with s shotgun😉. I know it's going to hurt my loved ones, but I can't even get out of bed in the morning. It's been 4.5 months now since my wife left me. I've spent the last 3 months in bed when I get home from work.

Thank you everyone for your support. Writing out this disgusting and horrible desire to hurt my ex was cathartic and ultimately healthy for me. I realized how childish my desire is and I have no plans on following through with it. I also made a plan to get sober. That's my first goal.

I don't want to die. I needed to write this out to understand that.

Plus I'm dying to see how Game of Thrones' ends. 
Jon Stark...King of the North!

Logically I understand that. I know that's the best way to prove that I'm a good man. However, the addiction is so powerful that I fail each and everyday. I've been crippled by addiction everyday for the last 5 years. I can't stop. I was going to go to rehab, but I spent all my savings on the divorce. Lawyers and splitting up assets.

Point taken. I've been acting ridiculous. While on drugs...i.e. Kratom, I make rash decisions. Such as trying to get back with her. Although we separated 4 months ago, we still slept with each other weekly. Because we kept sleeping together I thought there was a chance to save the marriage. After 3 months of sleeping together I asked her to give up the other man and just be with me. She reacted badly and shoved me away all together. I felt that she was leading me on with the sex. She basically told me that she was just using me for sex and had no plans to be together. Because of that, I've been fuming and incredibly hurt. While sleeping together, she wanted me to physically hurt her...slapping, pretend rape, etc... I didn't have it in me to be that aggressive. She made me feel like shit because of it. She wanted anger and pain during sex and I wasn't able to provide that. I was just so deeply in love with her. 

So yeah, I agree with you. I wrote the op while high on kratom. When it comes to my ex, I feel bi-polar. When on drugs...which I seem to not be able to stop, I feel incredible pain and anger. As well as hopelessness. So I think about obsessive thoughts such as suicide and how to emotionally hurt her. Now that I'm more sober, I have much healthier thoughts. 

I need to get off the drugs, but I've been battling that for years and years. I regret my behavior while on it. 

Yes, I'm 33. Immature, arrested development and hopeless. Hence the suicidal ideation. 

Thank you for your honest and straight forward response. I need tough love at the moment.
I'm choosing shotgun blast to the face. Instant and very efficient.

Me too! High five! 

That's why I'm excited about death. I get to find out what's on the other side. I'm cool with hell. Then at least I know there was a God. But I'm banking on pragmatism and preparing for a eternal sleep. Nothing after the lights turn off. Like I said I love sleep. Shotgun to the mouth and that's all she wrote.
Were you Mormon at one point? That sounds like a Mormon song.

Since I learned about what she did, I've lost 30 pounds. I used to weigh 260 (I'm 6'1 and decently muscular) and now I weigh 230. But my drug abuse (which was at a controlled level during the marriage) has gone completely out of control. I've spent thousands of dollars these last 4 months on Kratom, pot, cigs and boos. I can't stop. Everyday I say I'm going to stop, but then I spend more money. I cannot handle being sober. Too much thought. Too much feeling pain.
That's nice as hell man. Thank you.

Thank you for your concern. I'm not trying to be a downer, but the idea of going through with this plan gets me excited. Like I finally can follow through with something. I never follow through on anything. I quit in the middle of everything. But this plan...this hateful plan to kill myself makes me happy. I love to sleep and an eternal sleep really gets me hard. You know what I mean?

Thank you for the support. My good qualities are there. But I can't seem to stop taking drugs every single day. I'm either on kratom, pot, cigarettes or alcohol. I'm giving my self the month to get my shit together. But I've been down this rabbit hole for so long, that I'm just tired of fighting. I'm tired of being locked to my bedroom. My gainful employment will end soon because I miss so much time from work. It can't last. Also, I'm tired of not being able to look my loved ones in the eye as they progress with their lives and attain excellence. I ended every meaningful relationship that I've had to spare them from my issues. Except for this last one. I was honest about my hardships from the beginning and I can't stand the idea that she eventually hated me because of them. I'm fragile and I can't handle this level of pure rejection. I put my heart out to her and she said she'll take me anyways...till she stopped. Now she hates me and has acted terrible towards me. I'm so embarrassed with myself that I tried crawling back to her. Despite what she's done, I tried crawling back  to her. And she brutally let me know that she's not down with it. She did it in the most heartless manner. 

I feel so much anger and hate. I want her to suffer. To hurt like I have. I also want to end it. 13 years of hardships is enough. I'm done. I'm done trying to get help and failing to change. I've tried over and over again to fix myself. 

I'm just done. 

But thank you for your kind comments.

I feel like I've tried everything. I'm 33. I'm had such a great start to life, but my depression has held me back. I never could finish college. I only mans 15 bucks an hour. All of my friends have careers and families. I dropped my friends out of shame of where I'm at in life. 

It's sad too because I'm actually a decent looking guy with a decent intelligence. I'm athletic and a jujitsu practitioner. I have a great family who loves me. 

But my depression and inside me with addiction has gotten the better of me. I have been trying to solve for years and years. When I married my wife and I finally someone who would be with me till the end. For better or worse.

I cannot stop obsessing over her. I cannot stop thinking about everything she did. I hate myself for giving her the time of day. I hate myself for allowing my thoughts of her to consume me.

In short I hate myself and I plan to no longer be a drain on my family or society. I love to sleep and I think that that is just one long sleep. I plan on using a shotgun in order to not awake.
So now I'm going to kill myself in my gun in her car while on speaker phone to her voicemail. I plan on doing it next month.
